status: @neo-ui-kit/react@1.0.1 published through GitHub OIDC, publicly available as latest, installed and verified from npm; public documentation verified.

baseline.workingTree: clean before edits; no pre-existing user modifications overwritten

contracts: Controlled proposals use the owner's current value; rejected requests do not advance hidden internal state.
InputBase-derived fields preserve explicit ARIA, stable IDs, errors and descriptions; button fields include their displayed value in the accessible name.
IME composition, disabled/readOnly, required Select validation, long-list keyboard scrolling and native React 18 refs corrected.
Form dotted paths, touched state, async validation races and removed private any-based path access corrected.
DataTable pagination emits once; visible detail rows and initial resize sizes match accessibility semantics.
Tooltip, Popover, Menu, Dialog, Tabs and FloatingPanel use their appropriate focus, keyboard, nesting, cancellation and state models.
AudioPlayer volume, disabled state and callback freshness; Waveform, RotaryKnob, PianoRoll and PianoKeyboard input/cancellation corrected.
i18n, Icon fallback, Form touched and Router params no longer confuse inherited object keys with user data.
visualAndResponsive: AnimatedBorder follows four independent elliptical corner radii and changing element sizes, without expanding scroll geometry or intercepting input.
Border glow correctly follows the light color scheme; selected/hovered Select text remains readable in light themes.
Long labels, feedback messages, actions, narrow media controls, dialog footers, Toast and mobile documentation navigation fit their containers.
NeonWaves immediately reprojects comets on resize instead of retaining coordinates from the previous width.
Reduced-motion behavior covers CSS entrances, ripples, Marquee and Tilt; paused/offscreen decoration releases unnecessary work.
Four existing palettes and their neon character are retained; no new Canvas/WebGL animation engine introduced.
architectureAndCleanup: Shared field IDs and native button behavior extended instead of creating parallel implementations.
Observers, async generations, timers and pointer ownership now have explicit cleanup/cancellation paths.
Unused imports and unused live-editor module mapping removed; UI and playground enforce noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters.
Side-effect-free React factories have targeted PURE annotations, allowing Button imports to drop unrelated artwork/audio.
Generated package declarations exclude documentation-only examples; generated asset-name declarations work without consumer skipLibCheck/resolveJsonModule.
Font generator source is excluded from the package; fonts, licenses and required artwork remain.
Static runtime dependency review found no cycles or production-to-demo imports in the configured UI module graph.
documentationAndDelivery: Each public React component, including core primitives, has a separate catalog page and executable example.
Installation instructions use npm install @neo-ui-kit/react; local archive instructions remain available for testing unpublished changes.
Root check and prepublish gates build and run the test suite.
ESM entry points share providers/contexts and externalize React; the actual tarball is installed in isolated React 18.2 and 19.3 applications.
The 1.0.1 documentation snapshot is published on GitHub Pages; registry installation, clipboard and live editor were verified in the public site.
The catalog supplies its existing wave mark as a self-contained SVG favicon; the browser check now rejects all console errors and rendered example-error fallbacks.
All 100 catalog descriptions have explicit EN and Ukrainian translations, covered by dedicated dictionary checks.

limitations: No physical low-end PC, physical mobile/touch device, real microphone/audio-output hardware, or screen reader was available. CPU throttling is emulation.
Installed Chrome and Edge were tested. Firefox, Safari/WebKit and older browser versions were unavailable and are not certified.
Axe and keyboard checks are not a complete WCAG certification. Exact manual SVG label findings are retained in accessibility-catalog.json with visual evidence.
Representative server rendering passes, but React 18 reports useLayoutEffect server warnings. Full SSR hydration support is not certified or newly promised.
Some low-risk static utilities received source review and indirect consumer coverage; exact distinctions and limits appear in each family audit.
Coverage is risk-based rather than an exhaustive Cartesian product of every prop, custom token, theme, input device and content size.
The existing QuantumFieldExperience depends on its documented third-party remote modules; live hardware/network availability is not guaranteed by these tests.
Neo UI is not legally cleared. Existing same-sector uses were found; live multi-jurisdiction trademark similarity clearance was not completed.
